description: This file defines the FooTable.Paging component, which adds pagination controls to a table, including methods for navigation, UI creation, and event handling.

classes.name: F.Paging
classes.description: A component that manages pagination controls for a FooTable instance, including UI generation, navigation, and event handling.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes the paging component with table options and sets default properties.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks and applies configuration options before UI creation, including enabling/disabling the component.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the paging UI after preinit, raising an event before creation.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the paging UI and cleans up the component, raising an event before destruction.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Performs paging calculations, updating the rows array to show only current page data.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Updates the pagination UI, creating links and setting navigation states.

methods.name: $create
methods.description: Creates the pagination UI elements based on current options.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates a formatted string with current paging info, replacing placeholders.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Navigates to the first page.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Navigates to the previous page.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Navigates to the next page.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Navigates to the last page.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates to a specified page number.

methods.name: prevPages
methods.description: Shows previous set of page links based on limit.

methods.name: nextPages
methods.description: Shows next set of page links based on limit.

methods.name: pageSize
methods.description: Gets or sets the number of rows per page.

methods.name: _set
methods.description: Handles the process of changing to a specific page, raising events accordingly.

methods.name: _createLinks
methods.description: Generates pagination link elements based on total pages.

methods.name: _setNavigation
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled state of navigation buttons.

methods.name: _setVisible
methods.description: Controls which page links are visible based on current page and limit.

methods.name: _onPageClicked
methods.description: Handles click events on pagination links, triggering navigation.
